sentences.text: A float plan tells someone ashore where you’re going and when you’ll be back, so that if you don’t return, a search starts quickly and in the right place.
Include who’s aboard, a description of the boat, your planned route, and your expected return time, plus instructions on when to call the Coast Guard.
Leave it with a responsible person, such as your office, marina or a family member.
Update it if your plans change, and cancel it when you get back.
